$comment: Justifications for every biome-ignore suppression in the repo. A suppression may only exist here, with a reason, if it genuinely cannot be avoided or Biome lacks support. Add a new entry + reason BEFORE introducing a suppression; the guard fails otherwise.

entries.why: Badge injects its children into the render element at runtime; the anchor is intentionally empty here.
Not covered by the dependency analysis for this memoized helper.
Dropzone wrapping a file input; the input provides keyboard and browser access on its own.
The cropped result is a runtime data URL produced on the client; next/image cannot optimize or serve it, so a plain img is the correct element.
Static pre-paint theme bootstrap string built from constants; no user input reaches it, and an inline blocking script is required to apply the theme class before first paint.
